disposition.note: BR16 records INT-19, INT-20, JOB-13 and JOB-15 as removed with no target; no lake file, copy or delivery row is created.
BR17 fixes the record layout and file pattern to the rwb-integration interface row and the claim-check reference. rwb-document contract already in the contract list.
BR14 answers run state from dispatch fields, workflow run and P2 status, with no run table. Edge-owner confirmation of any local guard is still open.
BR15 places JOB-10, JOB-13 and JOB-15 with the Ownership Map owners; rwb-integration registers no schedule.
BR13 keeps file and outbox tables in P2; debt_sale_account and recovery_case change by contract call or event.
Added AC20 (ownership write set and run state, BR13/BR14) and test row TC-ITG-E1007-10. New section 8 rules numbered BR13 to BR17 so that no ID repeats.
